palette: Totoy 36, hard alpha; no reserved gold x,y or red z,A
scale: 1x game pixels (nearest-neighbour; preview sheets are scaled copies)
status: Reference art for the human's approval; NOT imported into art/src, not in art/build, not wired into the game
frame_naming: <group>_<n>, n from 1; mirror around the anchor for a left-facing hero, as with the hero frames
aspect: Sprint (suggested display name: SPRINT; subtitle idea: 'WIND AT THE HEELS')
request: Totoy's movement speed is doubled for 3 s. Speed and duration are owner/core decisions.

groups.fx_sprint_start_<1..5>: 48x40, anchor (24,35) = feet. Start burst: ground flash, ring and a big dust kick back, lines, motes.
groups.fx_sprint_lines_<1..4>: 48x40, anchor (36,35) = feet (the lines trail to the left = behind a right-facing hero). Loop about 60 ms while sprinting and moving.
groups.fx_sprint_wind_<1..4>: 40x40, anchor (14,35) = feet. Wind streaks wrapping the front of the body and peeling back; loop about 70 ms. Draw over the hero.
groups.fx_sprint_dust_<1..6>: 40x16, anchor (28,12) = feet. Dust puffs from alternating feet, drifting back; loop about 60 ms while moving.
groups.fx_sprint_aura_<hero frame>_<1..6>: Faint pale-cyan outline overlay for the exact hero frame (same naming rule as fx_phantom_glow), cropped, anchor = the hero frame's feet in the crop. 6 phases about 80 ms, independent of the hero frame. Covered: idle 1-4, walk 1-6, dash 1-4 of hero2, totoy_dagger, totoy_scythe.
groups.fx_sprint_after_<hero frame>_<1..3>: Afterimages: the hero frame as a cyan ghost, 1 nearest/brightest to 3 faintest. Draw BEHIND the hero, at where he was 1, 2, 3 x ~150 ms ago, or at behind_px along the reverse facing; mirrored with him.
groups.fx_sprint_end_<1..4>: 48x40, anchor (24,35) = feet. The aura tears off in pale shreds, a last puff, a closing ring.

suggested_timeline: cast: fx_sprint_start 1-5 at the feet. For 3 s: aura on every frame, lines + dust while moving, wind loop, 3 afterimages while moving. End: aura off, fx_sprint_end 1-4.
